turns.input: *He looks at Blackthorn, trying to understand what kind of person he has in front of him.*
turns.draft:
Nicco studied the woman before him. Short—shorter than he'd expected for someone who apparently carried weight in whatever operation she ran—and round, dressed in a tailored suit the color of aubergine that somehow didn't look ridiculous despite its oddity. Her black bob framed a face with nearly black eyes, sharp and assessing. She had the air of someone who kept accounts rather than settled scores, though that didn't necessarily make her less dangerous.

Blackthorn returned his gaze without apparent discomfort, her expression neutral but attentive. Two large men flanked her at a respectful distance, their presence a quiet statement. She didn't speak, didn't fidget, simply waited with the patience of someone accustomed to evaluating business prospects.
